text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging priya (oncall) — high severity: repeated GPU OOMs on decode/streaming fleet (euca-decode-*/prod) causing request drops. Auto-throttle engaged. Logs show runaway generation + large max_tokens from a customer stream. https://internal.incidents/1738609123
priya (oncall): Acked. Looking. Which shard? any customer-facing impact yet? :eyes:
matt (infra): euca-decode-07 and euca-decode-12 hit OOMs, kube restarts happening. Pod restarts 3x in 5m. Node flaps observed on eu-west-2-gpu-3.
jordan (runtime): Root cause looks like a request with header override maxtokens=100000 + a prompt that triggers sampling loop. Runtime didn't enforce per-request token cap due to config mismatch after deploy. Example log snippet:
```
[2025-06-18T14:05:12Z] request_id=rd-8432 client=acme-stream max_tokens=100000 current_seq=1
[2025-06-18T14:05:13Z] decode: kv_cache growth=45GB gpu_mem=95%
[2025-06-18T14:05:14Z] cuda: out of memory
```
priya (oncall): Ok mitigation options: (1) enable router-side token-capping fallback to 4096, (2) pull nodes out of rotation, (3) fallback to CPU-safe variant, (4) contact customer to rate-limit. Which do we run first?
matt (infra): I'll drain euca-decode-07 and 12, cordon nodes eu-west-2-gpu-3. Scaling doesn't help immediate OOMs until KV eviction happens. Starting drain now.
jordan (runtime): I'm flipping the router policy to enforce per-request hard cap 4096 and enabling model-variant fallback to quantized-v1 for the decode pool. Patch rolling in 30s. Command: `./routerctl set cap --max-tokens 4096 --scope=decode-prod`
priya (oncall): Doing the router flip now. Will monitor for further OOMs. Notifying support to prepare customer comms.
carlos (support): Noted. We have a handful of 5xx tickets coming in; customer acme reported truncated streams. Drafting update: "We're mitigating an issue causing large generation requests to be dropped; applying temporary token caps and fallbacks, working on full fix." Want to include ETA?
jordan (runtime): ETA for config hotfix = ~10m. Longer-term fix: enforce token caps at model-serving layer + sanity-checks in SDK.
matt (infra): Drain complete for 07 and 12. New pods routed away. No further restarts in last 90s.
priya (oncall): Router cap flip complete. Observed immediate drop in memory growth on eu nodes. Telemetry: 5xx rate dropped from 6.3% -> 1.2% across decode pool in last 2m.
carlos (support): Sending initial note to affected customers now. Will route escalations to priya.
priya (oncall): Handing off to jordan for post-incident remediation + postmortem. Summary for handoff: GPU OOMs caused by runaway generation due to a client-supplied max_tokens override (100k) combined with a recent router/deploy mismatch that disabled hard caps. Mitigations executed: drained two nodes, enforced router hard cap 4096, enabled model-variant fallback to quantized-v1, customer notifications sent. Current status: service stable, continued monitoring for 30m.
jordan (runtime): Taking handoff. I'll open a follow-up ticket for SDK validation, add server-side hard caps, and schedule the postmortem. Assigning follow-ups: RUNTIME-1842 (server caps), INFRA-1220 (node-flap RCA), DEVEX-91 (SDK anti-overrides).
pagerduty-bot: Handoff recorded. Next oncall: matt (infra) at 1738610400.
priya (oncall): Thanks team. If anything flares, ping here. Posting a short incident note to the incidents channel and starting the timeline. :white_check_mark:
